tasks.title: Establish persistent control plane
tasks.objective: Save the complete task contract and recoverable queue before archaeology.
verification: Parse JSON; validate one active task; git diff --check
notes: Bootstrap JSON and task invariants verified before first checkpoint.

tasks.title: Inventory tracked repository and evidence files
tasks.objective: Inventory pinned Git tree without opening binary contents.
verification: Inventory counts match git ls-tree; JSON parse; repeat byte equality
notes: Inventory generated from the pinned audited SHA; repeat generation is byte-stable.

tasks.title: Extract document references
tasks.objective: Implement deterministic stdlib extraction with source lines and typed references.
verification: Scanner unit tests; compare repeated extraction
notes: Typed extraction includes source line, stable ID, raw token and source SHA context.

tasks.title: Validate local references
tasks.objective: Resolve paths, anchors and commits locally; separate remote existence and ambiguity.
verification: Temporary Git fixture tests; broken and historical target fixtures; deterministic run
notes: Local paths, Markdown anchors and commit SHAs are resolved offline; remote references remain unverified.

tasks.title: Normalize architecture and frozen Model V2 evidence
tasks.objective: Record source-grounded lifecycle and boundary relationships.
verification: Every selection has exact source and lifecycle justification

tasks.title: Normalize journey, companion, assets and Transcend evidence
tasks.objective: Record current authority and scoped historical observations without designing product changes.
verification: Read selected sources; verify relation endpoints and citations

tasks.title: Normalize auth, account, deployment and verification evidence
tasks.objective: Map security/data boundaries and CI/release evidence with scope limits.
verification: Read selected sources; no current-runtime inference from dated reports

tasks.title: Build authority graph and index
tasks.objective: Generate normalized records and typed, traceable relationships from curated sources.
verification: Graph schema/endpoint tests; curated quotation validation

tasks.title: Analyze and triage evidence gaps
tasks.objective: Separate confirmed local reference gaps from review candidates and unverified remote claims.
verification: Inspect representative failures and false positives; record confidence and follow-up

tasks.title: Generate atlas and document audit interface
tasks.objective: Provide compact domain maps and reproducible read-only check/regenerate commands.
verification: Read-only --check; byte-stable regeneration; output drift negative test

tasks.title: Final divergence review and verification
tasks.objective: Fetch main once, inspect incremental changes, finish checks and self-review.
verification: Targeted tests; relevant existing policy tests; ruff lint and format; git diff --check; boundary/commit review
